data.name: Fatna
data.gender_notes: Fatna is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fatna is a Quranic name that refers to the delight and joy one experiences in the presence of Allah. It is also associated with the concept of rapture and ecstasy. The name Fatna carries the meaning “Delight, Joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatna usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be in a state of delight and joy in the presence of Allah, and to be guided towards the path of righteousness.
data.etymology: Fatna belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatna total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: فاتنة
in_arabic.meaning: فاتنة تعني جميلة وفاتكة للقلوب بشدتها
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فاتنة مشتق من الفاتك والفواتك وهو الاسم الذي يوصف به الشديد الجمال والذي يفتك القلوب بشدته، ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن جمال وفتنة الدنيا، وله أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية كرمز للجمال الحسن الذي يجب أن يلهم المسلمين للتقوى والصلاح.

in_urdu.name: فاتنہ
in_urdu.meaning: فاتنہ کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور دل کو موہ لینے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام فاتنہ عربی زبان کی root ف ت ن سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں وہ چیز جو دل کو موہ لیتی ہے یا کسی کو موہنے والی، خاص طور پر خوبصورت چیز، فاتنہ کا ذکر اسلامی تقویم میں دل کو پکڑنے والی خوبصورتی کے طور پر کیا گیا ہے، اور یہ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی اور دل کو موہنے کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: फातना
in_hindi.meaning: फातना का अर्थ है सुंदर और मन को मोह लेने वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम फातना अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सुंदरता जो हृदय को मोह लेती है, यह इस्लामी परंपरा में सुंदरता और मन को मोहने की शक्ति का प्रतीक है, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में फातना का नाम सुंदरता और अच्छे चरित्र की निशानी माना जाता है.

in_pashto.name: فتنه
in_pashto.meaning: فتنه د ښکلا او د زړه د موهلو په معنا ده
in_pashto.long_meaning: د فتنه نوم د ف ت ن په ريښه مشتق دی، چې د ښکلا او د زړه د موهلو په معنا ده، په پښتني کلتور کې فتنه د يوې ښکلۍ نجلۍ په نوم يادېږي، چې د خپل ښکلا او سحروني قدرت سره د زړونو د موهلو توان لري، دا نوم د پښتنو په ميراثي او کلتوري داستان کې ځانګړی اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Fatna
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fatna originates from the Arabic root 'f-t-n', meaning 'to tempt' or 'to captivate', particularly with beauty, it is mentioned in the Quranic context as a description of worldly beauty and temptation, Fatna holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition as a symbol of beauty and moral character.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Fatna is often given to girls as a sign of their unique personalities and the joy they bring to their families. The name has a rich literary association, appearing in several Hadiths and history books. For instance, in one famous Hadith, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) was heard reciting the name "Fatima" (another name derived from the same root) as a form of dua or supplication, expressing his deep affection and respect for his beloved daughter Fatima bint Muhammad, who is considered as a role model of piety and devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Fatna is rooted in its etymology and the concepts it evokes. It denotes the delight, rapture, and ecstasy that a true believer experiences in the presence of Allah. It also reflects the joy that Allah takes in His creation and in their act of worship and devotion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Delight, Joy" symbolizes Fatna is a Quranic name that refers to the delight and joy one experiences in the presence of Allah. It is also associated with the concept of rapture and ecstasy.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fatna serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of delight, joy.
